name: SVC_COLLAB_ACTION_ATTRS
description: This table holds the attributes from request and response payloads of the slack requests.

columns.name: ATTRIB_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: DEEP_LINK
columns.description: Deep link for the collaboration attribute.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: The type of the data source if this attribute is chosen with a dropdown menu, for example static or external (dynamic).

columns.name: ATTRIB_NAME
columns.description: Value of the attribute which should be part of the slack payload command

columns.name: DATA_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Data type code of the attribute, e.g. String, CLOB, etc. Can be used to know if any conversions need to happen.

columns.name: CONTROL_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Type of the control, example: text, textarea, select.

columns.name: DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: Display name of the attribute that appears in user interface.

columns.name: DISPLAY_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Determines the order in which the attribute appears if it is a request attribute.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: API returns the data for list control type.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_LABEL_ATTRIB
columns.description: The data source attribute used to get the label of the lookup.

columns.name: DATA_SOURCE_VALUE_ATTRIB
columns.description: The data source attribute used to get the value of the lookup.

columns.name: REQUEST_ATTRIB_FLAG
columns.description: Y/N value indicating whether the attribute is response or request.

columns.name: RESPONSE_ATTRIB_FLAG
columns.description: Y/N value indicating whether the attribute is response or request.

columns.name: CONTEXT_ATTRIB_FLAG
columns.description: Y/N value indicating whether attribute will be used for co-relation.

columns.name: DEFAULT_VALUE
columns.description: Stores the default value of the attribute used for the collaboration action.

columns.name: COLLAB_ACTION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the SVC_COLLAB_ACTIONS table.

columns.name: DELETED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the message is logically deleted (Y or N).

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: CHANNEL_ID
columns.description: Channel ID that stripes the attributes based on the workspace. This is a foreign key from SVC_CHANNELS_B table.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
